description: A timer with two alarms and two counters. The timer counts elapsed hours, minutes, seconds and tenths of a second

params.text: Switches that alarm on and off
Switches that counter on and off

inputs.text: A trigger switches that alarm on and off
A pulse resets that counter to zero

outputs.text: Sends a pulse when the timer reaches that alarm's time
Goes high when the timer reaches that alarm's time
Sends a pulse when that counter reaches its target count
A voltage that rises as that counter runs, the count so far divided by the target count and multiplied by 10V

notes: the H, M and S digits of an alarm are set by clicking them, and that alarm fires when the timer reaches that time
a counter's TARGET digits are set by clicking them, and the COUNT digits beside them show how far that counter has got
pulses are sent as each tenth of a second, each second, each minute, each hour and each day rolls over
